en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding a man who had a slave girl for him, so he copulated with her, then freed her, and she had menstruated when with him, a menstruation after him having copulated with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would observe a waiting period of two menstruations’.
